promotion.reason: Qualified on 2026-09-10 and approved by the owner. A real install proved it starts, opens to a usable screen, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. v1.2.54 is the current release — the same version upstream published on 2026-08-29 — and the image was rebuilt that day. It ships a default admin password, which the risk notes say plainly rather than hiding.

risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Turning on the plugin installer lets Kanboard download and run plugin code from the internet on your computer. Leave it off unless you want that.

Kanboard starts with one account, username admin and password admin, and does not force a change. Anyone who can reach the address is an administrator until you change it, so change it the first time you sign in.
